name: No Photo Scene
description: You forgot to take pictues before investigating. Your credibility is completely ruined!

name: No Gloves
description: You did not wear gloves. How many of your own fingerprints have you collected?

name: Dirty Gloves
description: You did not change your gloves and contaminated the crime scene. Contrary to popular belief, these things don't magically clean themselves!

name: No Evidence Bag
description: You forgot to bag and tape evidence. You might as well have sent the evidence over with pigeon carrier!

name: Wrong Swab Type Wet
description: You used the wrong type of swab for blood collection. Save the dilution for the lab!

name: Wrong Swab Type
description: You used the wrong type of swab for blood collection.

name: Wrong Blood Test Order
description: You mixed up the steps of the Kastle-Meyer test. How'd you manage that?

name: False Positive Collected
description: You did not ignore a false positive.

name: No Presuptive Test
description: You failed to run a presumptive test. For all you know, it could be ketchup!

name: Test Swab Collected
description: You collected the test swab. If only there was a way to collect a fresh sample for testing.

name: Wrong Colour Dust
description: You used the wrong colour of powder. You might have more sucess collecting the print if you can actually see it!

name: No Picture Dusted Fingerprint
description: You did not take a picture of the dusted fingerprint. Let's hope you make no mistakes when lifting it!

name: No Scale Bar
description: You did not use a scalebar when collecting the fingerprint. Who needs chain of custody anyway?

name: No Picture Scale Bar
description: You did not take a picture of the fingerprint with the scale bar.

name: Missing Evidence
description: You failed to collect a piece of evidence. Don't push yourself too hard; it's not like anybody's future is on the line

name: Incomplete Fingerprint Development
description: You did not refine the bloody fingerprint.

name: No Developed Fingerprint Photograph
description: You did not photograph the developed fingerprint.
